entities.name: Camilo Nogueira Román
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Camilo Nogueira Román is a Spanish politician and engineer. He was a Member of the European Parliament between 1999 and 2004. He was part of the Galician Nationalist Bloc (BNG) and the Democratic Party of the Peoples of Europe, which took part in the Greens–European Free Alliance.

entities.name: Camilo Nogueira Román
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Camilo Nogueira Román is a Spanish politician and engineer. He was a Member of the European Parliament between 1999 and 2004. He was part of the Galician Nationalist Bloc (BNG) and the Democratic Party of the Peoples of Europe, which took part in the Greens–European Free Alliance.
